    Class
    Description
    EmailCodeAttempt
    A counted attempt at a sign-in code: the credential it belongs to and the stored code hash to compare the submitted code against.
    EmailCredential
    Credential representing an email address linked to an identity.
    EmailCredentialRepository
    Storage for EmailCredentials.

    Registers and revokes email credentials.
    EmailLinkIssuer
    Does the real work behind POST /ott/generate, off the request thread: looks up the address, stores the token's hash (the upsert that is also the resend limit), and sends the link.
    EmailLinkMessage
    A sign-in email to deliver: the link and the typed code that both complete the same sign-in.
    EmailLinkOutcome
    What EmailLinkIssuer.issue(String, String) did with a request.
    EmailLinkSender
    Delivers a sign-in link and code to an email address.
    EmailLinkSettings
    Settings for email sign-in links.
    EmailLinkTokenRepository
    Storage for sign-in link tokens.
    EmailSignInProof
    What a sign-in request at POST /login/ott presents: the token from the emailed link, the address and code typed by hand, or something malformed.
